channel.title: Robotics Directory - Commercial Robots
channel.description: Browse 672 commercial robots in the Robotics Directory. Specs, prices, images and comparison.

item.title: FarmDroid FD60
item.description: FD60 is FarmDroid’s larger battery-driven seeding and mechanical-weeding platform,introduced in autumn 2026 with customer deliveries planned from January 2027. It supports up to 20 rows and 6.75 m working width,using the 14 mm seeding system and stored RTK GPS seed coordinates. Solar charging is supplemented by a petrol generator that recharges the battery. It does not support the FD20 +Spray option. Daily and seasonal area targets are planning claims; orders do not prove delivered units.

item.title: Locus Robotics Locus Array
item.description: Locus Array is Locus Robotics’ mobile manipulation system for in-aisle picking, transport and order consolidation. The manufacturer announced its global launch on April 13, 2026 with early-access North American deployments and planned regional scaling. NeuraGrasp handles selected soft, porous and unpackaged items; continuous operation and mixed-fleet SKU coverage do not establish single-battery endurance, gripper load or universal item success.

item.title: SMP Robotics Systems Corp. Argus S5.4
item.description: Argus S5.4 is the NVIDIA Jetson Orin NX mobile AI/security platform announced March 2, 2026, with shipments stated to begin in March 2026. It supports accredited third-party developers and certified onboard software distributed through SMP Store. The announcement does not establish exact mass, dimensions, battery endurance, camera package, IP rating or current stock; S5.3 and historical S5.2 values are not transferred.

item.title: Greenfield Robotics BOTONY
item.description: BOTONY is Greenfield Robotics' autonomous agricultural robot for chemical-free mechanical weed control in broadacre crops such as soybeans, milo, cotton and corn. The manufacturer offers wheeled and tracked configurations and estimates approximately 7 acres per day per robot under optimal conditions. Cutting is optimally initiated when weeds reach 3–5 inches, with a specified 60-inch turn zone. Each robot uses the GreenTRIP RTK system for field mapping and autonomous navigation with a 15 km range radius and centimeter-level accuracy, onboard cameras with human-detection algorithms and geofencing, and the Operator software for remote monitoring and intervention. The company reports a 2025 leased fleet of 23 robots in seven states and 70 orders for 2026 delivery, and operates made-to-order without maintaining robot inventory.

item.title: Lucid Gravity Robotaxi
item.description: The Lucid Gravity Robotaxi is a purpose-built autonomous ride-hailing vehicle developed by Lucid, Nuro and Uber. It is based on Lucid’s all-electric Gravity SUV and uses the Nuro Driver with a 360-degree sensor array of high-resolution cameras, lidar and radars integrated into the body and a roof-mounted Halo module. NVIDIA DRIVE AGX Thor provides real-time AI compute; a Halo LED display shows passenger initials and trip status, and interactive screens control seats, climate and music. The layout fits up to six passengers with luggage space. Nuro, Lucid and Uber announced autonomous on-road testing at CES 2026, a 2026 launch in a major U.S. city and Houston service in 2027; they plan 20,000 or more vehicles and cite up to 450 miles of range. No numeric price, mass, dimensions, battery endurance, runtime, speed, IP rating or navigation accuracy is published.

item.title: AGIBOT G2 Air
item.description: G2 Air is a compact single-arm mobile manipulator announced April 17, 2026 for light-duty human-in-the-loop operations. The manufacturer release lists seven manipulator DOF, three-kilogram payload, 750–800 mm reach, width under 800 mm and speeds of at least 1.5 m/s. A UMI-isomorphic layout combines task execution with data capture. The proposed transition from assisted work to full autonomy is a roadmap, not proof of unsupervised operation.

item.title: Bear Robotics Servi Q
item.description: Servi Q is specified for 45 cm / 18-inch aisles and can reverse when there is no room to turn; backward bump detection is explicitly described. The table gives 45 kg robot mass, 30 kg total payload, 10 kg per tray and 10 kg bottom shelf, with two trays plus one bottom shelf. Adjustable one-, two- or three-tray layouts are configuration options, not additional robot models.

item.title: Bear Robotics Carti 400
item.description: Carti 400 is an explicitly named low-profile configuration with 400 kg maximum cargo and 90 kg robot mass. No mass or dimensions are copied from a neighboring payload configuration. General SLAM navigation accuracy is ±10 mm; QR-code docking accuracy is ±5 mm. Marker-assisted docking is not general unmarked localization accuracy.

item.title: Bear Robotics Carti 600
item.description: Carti 600 is an explicitly named low-profile configuration with 600 kg maximum cargo and 110 kg robot mass. No mass or dimensions are copied from a neighboring payload configuration. General SLAM navigation accuracy is ±10 mm; QR-code docking accuracy is ±5 mm. Marker-assisted docking is not general unmarked localization accuracy.

item.title: Bear Robotics Carti 1000
item.description: Carti 1000 is an explicitly named low-profile configuration with 1000 kg maximum cargo and 190 kg robot mass. No mass or dimensions are copied from a neighboring payload configuration. General SLAM navigation accuracy is ±10 mm; QR-code docking accuracy is ±5 mm. Marker-assisted docking is not general unmarked localization accuracy.

item.title: Bear Robotics Carti 1500
item.description: Carti 1500 is an explicitly named low-profile configuration with 1500 kg maximum cargo and 200 kg robot mass. No mass or dimensions are copied from a neighboring payload configuration. General SLAM navigation accuracy is ±10 mm; QR-code docking accuracy is ±5 mm. Marker-assisted docking is not general unmarked localization accuracy.

item.title: Simbe Robotics Tally 4.0
item.description: Tally 4.0 is the next-generation retail inventory robot publicly launched in Simbe’s January 12, 2026 manufacturer release. That release planned customer availability beginning mid-2026; the current family page names 4.0, without proving a present transaction or stock level. Announced capabilities include up to 12 h operation per charge, ultra-high-resolution and specialty cameras, enhanced 3D depth, dual fisheye 360° sensing and NVIDIA edge computing. Faster charging has no exact elapsed duration in the selected text. No exact 4.0 mass, dimensions, payload, ingress rating or retail price is established.

item.title: Wandercraft Eve
item.description: Eve is Wandercraft's self-balancing personal exoskeleton for adults with spinal cord injury. It walks hands-free, without crutches, using 12 motors. It is FDA-cleared, available by prescription and used with a trained companion. It went on sale in the US on 17 September 2026, with other regions to follow.

item.title: Amazon Ring Rover Cam
item.description: Ring Rover Cam is Ring's autonomous indoor security robot for businesses, announced on 10 November 2026. Its AI Pilot system maps the premises, suggests patrol points and navigates around obstacles on its own. An adjustable periscope mast camera streams and records video at up to 4K. It also has a built-in siren and light tower, two-way audio and continuous person-motion detection. Sleep Mode retracts the periscope and mutes the microphone. Scheduled patrols require a compatible Ring Protect plan. US preorders open on 16 December 2026 at 999.99 USD. Amazon publishes no battery life, speed, mass, dimensions or drive details.

item.title: VideoRay Wraith
item.description: Mission Specialist Wraith modular tethered underwater ROV with ten (four horizontal, six vertical/lateral) thrusters and 6 controlled motion DOF. Wraith Expeditionary configuration is identified in the 2026 comparison guide. Battery-powered platform supports attitude control; speed definitions differ between sources. Base dry mass and manipulator piloting lift are separate from tether retrieval capacity, thrust and complete deployment kit mass.

item.title: Skydio R10
item.description: R10 is Skydio’s compact indoor/confined-space aircraft publicly introduced on September 17, 2025, with early access targeted for fall 2025 and general availability then targeted for the first half of 2026. Its dedicated specifications give 785 g including battery, 263.0 × 260.5 × 61.5 mm, up to 20 min flight and separately up to 3 h landed Perch Mode. Forward stereo navigation covers 180°, not 360°. Built-in visible-light NightSense, a 1-inch 12.5 MP camera, audio and software integration support inspection and remote monitoring. Charging is 35 min at 230 W or one hour at 100 W per battery from 0–100%. No numeric aircraft IP rating, current stock or complete-system price is established.

item.title: Ambi Robotics AmbiStack
item.description: AmbiStack is Ambi Robotics’ configurable overhead stacking system, publicly introduced January 28, 2025. The current FAQ permits cases up to 50 lb each and 52×32×32 in; those are handled-case limits, not robot mass, dimensions or aggregate multi-pick capacity. It supports mixed/SKU-based palletizing and multiple output formats, with 6/12/more positions as layout choices. Sim2Real planning and vision support two-case multipicking, while operators or separate AMRs/AGVs remove completed pallets. Light-curtain zones let a gantry work on one half while the other is replenished. A June 30, 2026 company release reports integration with Pickle Robot’s separate truck-unloading machines; 2025 deployment targets and current complete-system price/stock remain distinct.

item.title: Badger Technologies Digital Teammate
item.description: Digital Teammate is Badger’s current named retail robot/software platform, publicly launched on May 8, 2025 with summer availability announced. Cameras, rotating LiDAR and other sensors support autonomous shelf and floor monitoring around shoppers; the robot returns to its charging station after a cycle. Manufacturer sources state an approximately sixteen-hour battery, without full duty/test conditions. RFID item confirmation requires tagged products and configured equipment; overhead cameras, tablet/retail media and integrations retain deployment scope. Alerts guide store associates rather than proving physical shelf replenishment or spill cleanup. Historical Retail inSight/inSpect and named Marty deployments are not all certified as the same hardware revision.

item.title: Exotec Skypod Next Generation
item.description: Skypod Next Generation is the compact redesigned mobile robot within Exotec’s next-generation AS/RS commercially announced on February 6, 2025. It works with robot-to-robot picking Workstations,an Exchanger and denser storage. Exotec reports integrated buffering,outbound sequencing and pick-and-pack for each and case picking. Reported throughput and storage-density improvements compare complete systems; they do not establish faster individual robot travel or precise robot dimensions.

item.title: Zipline P2 Zip
item.description: Fixed-wing eVTOL home-delivery drone. It hovers at about 300 ft while a tethered, thruster-guided droid lowers packages onto a target about one meter across. It docks and recharges autonomously and has a 10-mile service radius.

item.title: Novarc Technologies SWR+TIPTIG Autonomy
item.description: Fully autonomous TIPTIG (hot-wire TIG) pipe-welding system that welds with no operator intervention. Novarc claims up to 4 lb/h deposition and up to 300% faster travel than conventional TIG. It has a 4 x 4 ft footprint and supports up to four positioners. It was unveiled at Schweissen & Schneiden in September 2025.

item.title: Vention Rapid Sanding Solution
item.description: Turnkey robotic sanding cell from Montreal-based Vention, built on a FANUC CRX-30iA cobot with a laser panel-measurement system and a PushCorp sanding tool. It was developed with 3M for cabinet-making and woodworking. It launched in February 2025 as part of Vention's Rapid Series.

item.title: Husarion Lynx
item.description: Lynx is Husarion's outdoor wheeled robot platform (v1.0). It has a 720 Wh hot-swappable battery, a 65 kg payload, 90% grade climbing with 36 kg of cargo, and IP54 or IP66 sealing. It won the Best Radiation Mapping Award at EnRicH 2025.

item.title: Lifeward ReWalk 7
item.description: Seventh-generation FDA-cleared personal exoskeleton for people with T7-L5 spinal cord injuries. It has crutch-button control, several walking speeds, stair activation and tracking in the MyReWalk app. US sales began in April 2025.

item.title: German Bionic Exia
item.description: AI-augmented powered back exoskeleton that gives up to 38 kg of dynamic lift assistance. It is aimed at logistics, industry, construction and nursing.

item.title: German Bionic Apogee ULTRA
item.description: Powered exoskeleton revealed at CES 2025. It gives up to 80 lb (about 36 kg) of dynamic lift assistance plus walking support, with AI-personalised assistance and over-the-air updates.

item.title: Dusty Robotics FieldPrinter 2
item.description: FieldPrinter 2 is Dusty Robotics’ second-generation commercial layout robot, announced in January 2024. It prints coordinated digital models at full scale on jobsite floors, controlled by a single operator through an iPad workflow with external laser tracking. Layout-to-model accuracy is stated as one-sixteenth of an inch. The current service includes hardware, platform access and implementation; exact current physical/range/runtime limits are not verified from the blocked support material.

item.title: Mobile Industrial Robots MiR1200 Pallet Jack
item.description: Autonomous EU-pallet handling with a 1200 kg load rating and machine-learning-based pallet perception. Overview and specification pages disagree on runtime. Metric dimensions, weight conversion and maximum fork height need confirmation before installation planning.

item.title: VideoRay Ally
item.description: Mission Specialist Ally modular tethered underwater ROV with four (two horizontal, two vertical) thrusters and 4 controlled motion DOF. Control and accessory packages support underwater inspection and intervention. Subsea battery availability depends on the named model and selected integration. Base dry mass and manipulator piloting lift are separate from tether retrieval capacity, thrust and complete deployment kit mass.

item.title: Seegrid Seegrid Lift CR1
item.description: Seegrid Lift CR1 is Seegrid’s autonomous pallet-handling lift truck for higher/heavier industrial placements up to 15 feet. Computer vision, LiDAR/SLAM and fleet software support material handling. Robot mass, complete body envelope, numeric positioning tolerance and one-battery duration remain unknown in selected accessible evidence; fork dimensions and automatic charging are separate scopes.

item.title: Intuitive Surgical da Vinci 5
item.description: da Vinci 5 is Intuitive’s fifth-generation multiport surgical system, commercialized in 2024. The IS5000 architecture separates the surgeon console, patient-side robot and vision tower, with compatible force-feedback instruments and integrated electrosurgical/insufflation functions. A September 8, 2026 FDA record describes a multi-arm targeting software update; it is not a new base robot or proof every installed unit has that update. No numeric complete-system mass, outer size, cargo, battery endurance, charge duration or motion-accuracy guarantee is established. Clinical indications and compatible tools vary by system, version and jurisdiction; no autonomous surgery or guaranteed clinical outcome is claimed.

item.title: XYZ Robotics RockyLight
item.description: Compact mobile manipulator for warehouse case picking and mixed-case palletizing. A vertically lifting arm base, individually controlled gripper cups and 3D perception support multi-case pickup and individual placement. The stationary RockyLight SE is a separately named configuration.

item.title: Bear Robotics Carti 100
item.description: Carti 100 is a modular industrial AMR with 100 kg total cargo capacity. The manual separates top and middle trays at 15 kg each from the 70 kg bottom tray; 100 kg is not a per-shelf allowance. The manual lists up to 0.8 m/s in safe-drive mode and 1.2 m/s maximum. Its three-hour contact-charge specification covers only 1% to 75%, not an empty-to-full recharge.

item.title: Aescape Robotic Massage
item.description: Fully automated massage table that uses two robotic arms. It builds a 3D body scan from over one million data points to personalize each session, and is deployed at Equinox clubs, hotels and Massage Envy locations.

item.title: Virtual Incision MIRA Surgical System
item.description: First miniaturized robotic-assisted surgery device, with a tray-to-table design that needs no dedicated OR layout. FDA De Novo-authorized for colectomy in 2024.

item.title: Draganfly Apex
item.description: Compact, transportable surveillance UAV for military and law enforcement, derived from the Commander 3XL. It has quick-release payloads and optional NVIDIA Jetson Orin onboard computing. Draganfly states up to 45 minutes of flight time and a 5 lb payload. It launched in September 2024.

item.title: Draganfly Flex FPV
item.description: NDAA-compliant modular FPV drone system for government and defence, with arm assemblies that swap between sizes in minutes. It launched in May 2024 as the FlexForce Modular FPV System. The current page lists 5-, 7-, 10- and 13-inch configurations, 450 g to 3 kg of payload and speeds up to 90 mph.

item.title: Ascento Guard 2.0
item.description: Second-generation Ascento Guard patrol robot. It has better night vision, a thermal camera with 160% higher resolution, longer person-detection range, a brighter spotlight and a 4:1 charge ratio. It balances and rights itself on and off road.

item.title: Oceanbotics SRV-8X OPTIMUS ROV
item.description: SRV-8X OPTIMUS ROV is an Oceanbotics remotely operated inspection/recovery platform. Current product-table and linked-sheet OCR separate listed vehicle weight from battery-excluded mass: 32 kg listed weight; separately 24 kg without batteries; tools/configuration basis otherwise unspecified. Dimensions are 64 × 51 × 43 cm (length × width × height) and depth scope is 350 m standard; 500 m and 1200 m are separately configured options. The manufacturer rates up to 8 h with two hot-swappable modules, separately from optional direct surface power. Company history explicitly launches SRV-8X Optimus on March 22, 2023 and describes a historical 500 m configuration. Current 350 m standard and deeper options remain configuration-specific; current pages shorten the name to SRV-8X. Tether breaking-strength text conflicts: HTML copper 544 kg/fiber 350 kg versus sheet OCR copper 350 kg/fiber 544 kg, configuration/revision unresolved. Numeric cargo, charge time, travel speed and positioning accuracy remain unverified.

item.title: Skydio X10
item.description: X10 is Skydio’s inspection/response aircraft publicly launched September 20, 2023. Current specifications separate Connect SL 2.11 kg from SL+5G Gen 1 2.14 kg and Gen 2 2.16 kg, all including battery, with 2.49 kg maximum takeoff mass. The aircraft is IP55, with up to 40 min ideal-lab flight versus 35 min hover; a later company article describes approximately 30–32 min practical mission battery capacity without making that a universal measured minimum. Six navigation cameras provide 360° sensing. Modular visual/thermal packages, controller generations, battery revisions, partial/full charge windows and cellular conditions remain separate. No price, certified payload subtraction, universally precise crack detection or blanket flight authorization is established.

item.title: Event 38 E455
item.description: E455 is Event 38’s heavier-payload fixed-wing VTOL platform launched in November 2023. It advertises over two hours with 7 lb payload below 55 lb total, while the 12 lb option has separate takeoff-weight conditions. The product page and launch announcement differ on maximum gross weight. Open payload/radio integrations and the DROPS partnership expand configurations without establishing that every unit includes them.

item.title: Fourier Intelligence MetaMotus Galileo
item.description: Configurable biomechanics and training platform combining a six-DoF motion platform, dual-belt treadmill, force/pressure measurement and virtual environments. Optional robot integrations remain distinct from the platform’s own motion-stage count.

item.title: XYZ Robotics RockyOne
item.description: Mobile manipulator for loading and unloading cartons in trucks and containers. An omnidirectional base, 3D vision and multimodal gripper support side, top or supported case handling. Manufacturer maximum payload and footprint are separated from site-specific case limits and complete robot dimensions.

item.title: Bear Robotics Servi Plus
item.description: Servi Plus has configurable two-to-four-tray layouts with a 40 kg total maximum and 10 kg per-tray limit; sixteen entrees is an example, not a dish-size-independent guarantee. The manual gives 62 kg robot mass, 535 x 590 x 1230 mm dimensions and up to 0.8 m/s in safe-drive mode; the maximum 1.2 m/s speed is a separate limit.

item.title: Ambi Robotics AmbiSort B-Series
item.description: AmbiSort B-Series is Ambi Robotics’ modular induction and sorting system, introduced June 6, 2023. Robot arms use multi-suction parcel grasping, a central conveyor and six-sided scanning to route to configured containers or exception outputs. The launch claims over 1,200 parcels/h, while the linked 2023 guide’s specification footnote states a three-induction-cell configuration. The current configurator says each pick cell adds 500 sorts/h; this is not a universal one-cell or complete-line guarantee. The launch’s over 99.5% accuracy and guide’s different accuracy/sortability contexts remain supplier claims, not dimensional vision precision. Input, outputs, arm count and layout are configuration choices; operators replenish full containers.

item.title: Cellula Robotics Guardian AUV
item.description: Extra-large uncrewed underwater vehicle for subsea surveillance, powered by a hydrogen fuel-cell air-independent propulsion system; it was formerly called Solus-XR. The manufacturer states over 45 days of submerged endurance, a 5000 km range, modular 2500-litre payload bays, an 8-knot speed and a size that fits a 40 ft ISO container. Sea trials began in 2023.

item.title: Ascento Guard
item.description: Two-wheeled-leg autonomous security patrol robot for large outdoor sites, offered as robotics-as-a-service. It works in all weather, uses thermal, RGB and infrared cameras and charges itself.

item.title: German Bionic Apogee+
item.description: Powered, IP54-rated lifting exoskeleton for nursing and patient handling. Its motors give about 30 kg (66 lb) of lifting support. It went on sale in December 2023.

item.title: Seegrid Seegrid Lift RS1
item.description: Seegrid Lift RS1 is Seegrid’s autonomous pallet-handling lift truck for low-lift warehouse and staging workflows. Computer vision, LiDAR/SLAM and fleet software support material handling. Robot mass, complete body envelope, numeric positioning tolerance and one-battery duration remain unknown in selected accessible evidence; fork dimensions and automatic charging are separate scopes.

item.title: Locus Robotics Locus Vector
item.description: Locus Vector is Locus Robotics’ omnidirectional warehouse AMR for collaborative case picking, putaway and point-to-point transport. Its current page states a 272 kg/600 lb payload, up to 14 hours runtime and approximately 50 minutes charging. A company-authored March 2022 introduction predates the 2023 launch wording in the current timeline; these milestones retain their source context.
